$comment: What an overview's title and charter may hold, for every writer: a founding, a review, a re-center and an editor (.context/overviews.md, "Charter limits"). The server reads it into config.overviews (server/src/lib/charterLimits.ts); the admin's charter and retitle forms import it. Characters, and OUT entries in all: the charter is copied into every link prompt. The prompts ask for a title, an IN of one or two sentences, short OUT phrases and one END_EVENT; the answer keys' longest IN is under 600 characters and their longest END_EVENT under 350.
